source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
Go through everything listed on the maintenance report.
3. Find the element(s) that we're interested in.
    * Sometimes there will be multiple element names or pictures. We want all of them.
4. Save the whole page, ideally as a PNG
    * If you have a PDF, you can use [pdftoppm](https://www.xpdfreader.com/).
        * Run: `pdftoppm -png input.pdf -`
    * Your screenshot should look like the following:
        * Something that closely resembles:
            * ![Sample maintenance image](../assets/sample_maintenance.png)
            * When you have the rest of the maintenance record and the specific defect is not clearly visible,
              refer to this [documentation about how to specify defects](assets/sample_annotation.pdf)
5. Annotate it with markdown. The specific syntax we use
